status: Official Jetson STEP solids + official D435 ROS mesh; camera analytic clearance volume checked independently

jetson.mounting: Retain original plastic base; removable perimeter retention and tray, not assumed through-base holes
jetson.bounds_basis: Conservative bounds of installed official solid BRep; actual foot datum, not control-box minimum, is on trayZ33.

d435.model_drawing_difference: 2018 official ROS mesh depth25.05 versus 2025 manufacturer drawing26.05; no mesh scaling used
d435.alternate_current_drawing_configuration: Remove1mm shims and selectM3x5 for26.05mm-deep camera; nominal engagement2mm. Measure supplied hardware before installation.
d435.official_CAD_format: D435_Solid.SLDPRT; retained as supplied, not read by this FreeCAD installation
d435.model_in_FCStd_and_STL: Official ROS mesh, original metres converted to mm; not a reverse-engineered box
d435.STEP_representation: Conservative analytic clearance volume; official SolidWorks source provided separately
d435.bracket_grip_stack: 3mm PETG plus1mm removable metal shim for25.05mm camera

imu.mass_basis: Manufacturer specifies <11g; use11g conservative purchased-component mass.

mounting.bridge_3mm_fastener_example: M2.5x16, bridge clearance2.7mm, underside nut2mm; verify actual head/nut dimensions.
mounting.front_2xM2: Type-C locking plate holes, 15mm pitch; not the vertical mounting holes.

origin_evidence.figure: 9: HI13 mechanical dimensions and IMU position
origin_evidence.nominal: Red IMU dot: D4=12,E3=12,A3=6 from body datum edges/bottom.
origin_evidence.limit: Published nominal module datum, not per-unit calibrated die-centre metrology; assembly and sensor extrinsic calibration remain required.

orientation.note: Directions refer to existing numerical CAD axes. Matrix must be applied to raw vectors; attitude conversion needs explicit frame convention. No reflections.

imu.sensor_configuration: R2 has accelerometer+gyroscope, no magnetometer, no barometer.
imu.mounting_guidance: Rigid flat mounting; avoid concentrated heat and cable stress; validate vibration on assembled robot. Do not add unqualified soft isolation in control IMU path.
imu.usb_keep_out: Design allowance20x12x9mm only, not measured cable geometry.

manufacturing: PETG camera bracket uses captive metal M3 nuts. No printed load-bearing leg joints.
limits: Display active area, mass, casing front-rim contact, plugs and cable geometry await physical measurement. Jetson and HI13R2 use official solid CAD; D435 uses official ROS mesh in FCStd/STL and an analysis envelope in STEP; display/battery are dimensional envelopes.
